disagreement.note: document_level_disagreement_pct: % of multi-annotator docs where annotators' independently-derived document labels disagree. span_level_disagreement_pct: % of individual sensitive spans with no overlapping corroborating span from a different annotator in the same doc. inflation_factor_doc_over_span quantifies how much the doc-level OR-of-spans disjunction inflates apparent disagreement relative to the span level.

adjudicated_subset.note: Pairwise Cohen's kappa pooled across quality_checked-annotator pairs in documents with >=2 quality_checked annotators — the human agreement ceiling for the primary evaluation set.
adjudicated_subset.warning: Kappa=0.162 is below the conventional 0.4 'fair agreement' threshold. The primary evaluation set's security_confidential_only label is noisy: automated-method scores against it measure agreement with an inconsistently-applied human label, not ground-truth correctness. State this plainly in the paper and adjust the external-validation framing accordingly.

span_level_agreement.note: Cohen's kappa over span pairs between every annotator pair in each multi-annotator document (one direction per unordered pair, to avoid double-counting). A span with no counterpart in the other annotator's set is paired against that field's own negative category (NO_MASK / NOT_CONFIDENTIAL) rather than dropped — a missed or extra span is itself a disagreement, and dropping it would inflate kappa by only scoring the easy cases where both annotators agreed a span existed at all. exact_match pairs spans with identical character offsets only; partial_overlap pairs each span with the other annotator's max-overlapping span. identifier_type (DIRECT/QUASI/NO_MASK) is compared against confidential_status (NOT_CONFIDENTIAL + 5 special categories) over the SAME span alignment, so any kappa gap between the two fields is attributable to the label, not the alignment.
